comparisons.reason: Feature 0 requires an explicit quotation of OP title/body text in the comment AND a dispute of that quoted material; paraphrase or unquoted objections score 0. Feature 1 counts any specific, concrete counterargument aimed at an OP claim, with no quotation requirement. Feature 1 is materially broader, so a comment with a specific rebuttal and no quote would be 1 for feature 1 and 0 for feature 0. The two are a narrow subtype versus a broad construct.
